name: minami2024-reading-lora
notes: Paper reports effective batch size 20 and LoRA (r=16, alpha=64) on q/k plus embedding and lm-head. This config uses microbatch 1 x accumulation 20 for a single GPU. The paper also adds KL divergence to the pre-fine-tuning distribution (lambda=0.05); the generic TRL SFT runner does not implement that custom loss, so this config is a near-reproduction rather than bit-exact.
